draft.goal: Propose the whole setup of the owner's network from what is already known. Read the network first (load_network). Then draft EACH machine (draft_machine) and the team (draft_network); every element that is not a measured fact is an assumption and names what it rests on. Apply the owner's correction when one is pending (apply_edit). Ask the owner (ask_owner) only when two candidate drafts differ in something only the owner can decide. finish_draft states what changed and what is still assumed. Nothing is installed.

done.reason: the draft is complete and waits for the owner to approve it or correct it; nothing was installed

no_machines.reason: no paired machine has a stored analysis, so there is nothing to draft; analyse the machines first
